title: Large multi-panel experimental rig with five vertical filter panels in a workshop
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

Five large vertically mounted rectangular panel assemblies are visible along the front face of the metal frame; each panel assembly has a grid of narrow vertical strips (the panels are contiguous across the front).
One rectangular metal frame structure encloses the top and sides of the panels (frame visible across the top and down the sides).
One small two-step stool/bench is visible on the right foreground in front of the frame (bench appears partly worn/dusty).
One vertical ladder is visible in the mid-background, rising behind the frame toward the ceiling.
A stack of three blue rectangular boxes or cabinets sits on the left side of the image (stacked vertically).
Two cylindrical vertical vessels or assemblies with visible flange/valve connections are visible at the left foreground near the base of the frame.

Multiple clear flexible tubes and hoses are visible exiting from the bottom of the panels and running along the floor and frame (individual tube count not determined due to overlap; at least several separate tubes are visible).
Several small electrical or control components are mounted on the top of the frame and around the panels (exact count and labels not legible).
A curved yellow corrugated hose or duct is visible in the right background, attached to equipment behind the frame.
A curtain or hanging partition is visible in the background behind the left side of the rig.
spatial_relations: The five vertical panel assemblies are mounted side-by-side across the front horizontal span of the rectangular metal frame, with narrow vertical separators between some panels.
The metal frame forms a raised rectangular cage above and around the panels; the top horizontal members run left-to-right across the image.
The two cylindrical vessels with flange/valve connections are positioned at the left front corner of the frame, adjacent to the leftmost panel assembly.
The stack of three blue boxes is located to the left rear of the frame, behind the cylindrical vessels and near the curtain/hanging partition.
The small two-step stool sits on the floor in front of the rightmost portion of the frame, slightly inset from the front edge of the panels.
Clear flexible tubes emerge from the bottom edges of the panels and route downward and rearward underneath the frame and toward the right side of the image.
A vertical ladder stands behind the frame closer to the center-rear of the scene; other workshop fixtures and cabinets are behind and around the rig.
colours_and_materials: The rectangular metal frame is primarily rust-coloured/orange-brown (perforated metal strut sections).
The five panel faces have a yellowish vertical strip pattern on a pale backing (yellow strips alternating with pale/cream areas).
The floor is blue, with a black textured mat under and in front of the frame on the right side.
The two vertical cylindrical vessels at left are grey/metallic with red valve handles.
The three stacked boxes at left are blue with darker edges.
A large corrugated hose in the right background is yellow.
